out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: OBSERVED NO HANDSOAP AT THE HANDWASHING SINK IN THE WAREWASHING AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. CDI: SOAP PROVIDED TO SINK DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: OBSERVED A WASHCLOTH IN THE HANDWASHING SINK IN THE SERVING AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. CDI: WASHCLOTH REMOVED.

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: OBSERVED NO PAPER TOWELS AT THE HANDWASHING SINK IN THE WAREWASHING AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. CDI: PAPER TOWELS PROVIDED TO SINK DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. OBSERVED BOTTLES OF WATER STORED ON THE FLOOR.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. PLEASE MOVE WATER TO A LOCATION 6IN ABOVE THE FLOOR BEFORE YOUR NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. CDI: PIC DECIDED TO TAKE COOLER OFFLINE AS SHE AS ROOM IN OTHER COOLERS FOR MILK. PIC UNDERSTANDS IF SHE IS TO USE THIS COOLER FOR FACILITY FOOD, IT MUST BE REPAIRED TO HOLD FOOD AT 41F OR BELOW.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Open drinking containers used or stored in a manner that may contaminate food, food contact surfaces or utensils. Observed coffee mugs being stored on shelving above food storage
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. Person in charge agreed to take the open top coffee mugs home

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. PIC moved wiping clothes to sanitizer solution buckets
